'''2006 North Dakota State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 8 July 2006 at Paradox Cards & Comics, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota, with [[Tyler Vastag]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-10491-143421">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=143421#p143421 ND States Championship], tvas27 (Tyler Vastag), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Sam Tashima]] won with a 5–1 record.<ref name="sf-10491-145727">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=145727#p145727 ND States Championship], _maul (Alden Peterson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

Vastag announced the event on 26 June 2006 as a six-game open constructed tournament with a final confrontation between the top two players. Everyone who played received prize support from the Players Committee's Championship Package (six uncut sheets, two random booster boxes, six tournament foils, and posters and pins), and the winner received the chance to design a virtual card and a bye into Day 2 of the [[2006 World Championship|World Championship]]. Paradox had hosted the two previous North Dakota state championships, each attended by more than 30 players.<ref name="sf-10491-143421" /> On the eve of the event Vastag called it the last tournament in the Bespin region before the redux.<ref name="sf-10491-145206">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=145206#p145206 ND States Championship], tvas27 (Tyler Vastag), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (7 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Paradox Cards & Comics, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota<ref name="sf-10491-143421" />
* '''Dates:''' 8 July 2006<ref name="sf-10491-143421" />
* '''Time:''' 11:00 am<ref name="sf-10491-145064">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=145064#p145064 ND States Championship], tvas27 (Tyler Vastag), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (7 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Format:''' [[Open]] constructed, six games and a final confrontation between the top two players; decklists required, clear sleeves banned<ref name="sf-10491-143421" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $6<ref name="sf-10491-143421" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tyler Vastag]]<ref name="sf-10491-143421" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Sam Tashima]]<ref name="sf-10491-145727" />

== Results ==

Tashima won with a 5–1 record.<ref name="sf-10491-145727" /> [[Michael Raveling|Raveling]] finished second and declined the final confrontation, and [[Garrett Larson]] went 3–3.<ref name="sf-10491-145773">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=145773#p145773 ND States Championship], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Peter Jacobson]] finished third.<ref name="sf-10491-146057">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=146057#p146057 ND States Championship], Jeeps (Peter Jacobson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (10 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref> Tashima played two variations of decks by [[Alden Peterson]], with minor changes.<ref name="sf-10491-145865">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=145865#p145865 ND States Championship], Clone Maul (Sam Tashima), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 July 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125170235/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10491.html Internet Archive]</ref>
